semantic_contract.definition_en: produce spoken words in order to communicate
must_preserve: the communication is performed with spoken words or speech
must_not_imply: a specific language ability unless the source sense explicitly includes it
a conversation with multiple participants unless the source sense explicitly includes it

semantic_contract.definition_en: interpret written or printed linguistic symbols as language
must_preserve: the object interpreted is written or printed language
must_not_imply: studying or memorizing the text unless explicitly expressed
interpreting a non-linguistic sign, meter, or measurement

semantic_contract.definition_en: a frog: a tailless adult amphibian of the group commonly called frogs
must_preserve: the referent is a frog rather than a generic amphibian
must_not_imply: a tadpole or other larval stage
a figurative person or object called a frog

semantic_contract.definition_en: a planned social meeting between people with a romantic or potentially romantic purpose
must_preserve: the meeting has a romantic or potentially romantic social purpose
must_not_imply: a medical, business, or service appointment
a generic meeting with no romantic implication

semantic_contract.definition_en: an arrangement to meet or receive a service at a scheduled time
must_preserve: there is an arranged meeting or service at a scheduled time

semantic_contract.definition_en: a terrestrial or semi-terrestrial tailless amphibian conventionally called a toad
must_preserve: the referent is specifically a toad

semantic_contract.definition_en: a frog specifically identified as a bullfrog
must_preserve: the referent is a bullfrog, a narrower kind of frog

semantic_contract.definition_en: the broad taxonomic grouping containing adult frogs and toads
must_preserve: the member belongs to the broad frog/toad taxonomic neighborhood
must_not_imply: that frog and toad are exact lexical equivalents
that every member is conventionally called a frog
that every member is conventionally called a toad

semantic_contract.definition_en: a particular day identified in a calendar system
must_preserve: the referent is a calendar day or calendar designation

semantic_contract.definition_en: a male monarch or royal ruler
must_preserve: the referent is a male royal ruler
must_not_imply: a generic leader with no royal status

semantic_contract.definition_en: a female royal person conventionally called a princess
must_preserve: the referent is a female member of a royal family or a woman holding the title princess

semantic_contract.definition_en: a male royal person conventionally called a prince
must_preserve: the referent is a male member of a royal family or a man holding the title prince

semantic_contract.definition_en: a round object used for play or games
must_preserve: the referent is a round play or game object
must_not_imply: a projectile or bullet unless context explicitly indicates it

semantic_contract.definition_en: a commitment that someone gives to do or keep something
must_preserve: there is a stated commitment or undertaking

semantic_contract.definition_en: a large area of land covered mainly with trees
must_preserve: the referent is a wooded land area

semantic_contract.definition_en: a deep human-made shaft or opening used to reach water
must_preserve: the referent is a well that gives access to water

semantic_contract.definition_en: the ordinary liquid substance water
must_preserve: the referent is liquid water
must_not_imply: a body of water specifically unless context says so

semantic_contract.definition_en: a large fortified or castle-like residence
must_preserve: the referent is a castle or fortified royal residence

semantic_contract.definition_en: a movable barrier that opens and closes an entrance to a room or building
must_preserve: the referent is a physical door at an entrance
must_not_imply: a doorway with no movable barrier unless the language sense covers both

semantic_contract.definition_en: furniture or a prepared place used for sleeping
must_preserve: the referent is a place or piece of furniture for sleeping

semantic_contract.definition_en: the heart as the organ associated with pumping blood, including ordinary figurative emotional reference to one's heart
must_preserve: the lexical referent is the heart
must_not_imply: a geometric heart symbol unless context explicitly indicates it
the central part of an object unless context explicitly indicates it

semantic_contract.definition_en: a wheeled passenger vehicle designed to be drawn by horses
must_preserve: the referent is a horse-drawn carriage

semantic_contract.definition_en: a person with whom someone has a relationship of mutual affection or companionship
must_preserve: the referent is a social friend
must_not_imply: an acquaintance with no friendship implication

semantic_contract.definition_en: an enclosed space inside a building
must_preserve: the referent is an interior room
must_not_imply: available capacity or space in the abstract

semantic_contract.definition_en: a vertical structure forming or dividing the side of a room or building
must_preserve: the referent is a physical wall
must_not_imply: a defensive city wall unless context indicates it

semantic_contract.definition_en: the early part of the day, typically from waking or sunrise until around midday
must_preserve: the referent is the morning period of a day

semantic_contract.definition_en: a large domesticated hoofed mammal commonly ridden or used to pull vehicles
must_preserve: the referent is a horse

semantic_contract.definition_en: a person whose role is to serve or work for another person or household
must_preserve: the referent is a person serving another person or household
must_not_imply: a government civil servant unless context indicates that sense

semantic_contract.definition_en: the place where a person lives or belongs
must_preserve: the referent is someone's home or place of living
must_not_imply: a building considered only as a physical house

semantic_contract.definition_en: a seat for one person, typically with a back
must_preserve: the referent is seating furniture for one person
must_not_imply: the leader of a meeting or committee

semantic_contract.definition_en: a person described in a story as using witchcraft or magic
must_preserve: the referent is a person characterized as a witch or magical practitioner

semantic_contract.definition_en: a magical enchantment or spell placed on a person or thing
must_preserve: the referent is an enchantment produced by magic

semantic_contract.definition_en: the positive emotional state of being happy or feeling joy
must_preserve: a positive emotion of happiness or joy is expressed
must_not_imply: mere satisfaction with a technical result unless it is emotional
